plan.title: Factory Gate/Check Template Reproduction — greenfield + brownfield injection
plan.goal: Codify our gates/checks/discipline as a stack-adaptable template bundle and have the greenfield + brownfield workflows install + activate it into every project the factory works on — a true software factory stamps its quality apparatus into its output.
success_criteria: A new (greenfield) target repo, after factory start, has WORKING git hooks + a tier0-style gate that blocks a bad commit + a projected PM tracker + trunk protection + agent scaffolding, adapted to its stack
An existing (brownfield) repo gains the same, installed NON-DESTRUCTIVELY (merge-not-clobber, confirm-before-replace, Rule-12 backups)
The bundle self-tests; installed gates are proven live (not dormant copies)
This repo remains the gate SSOT; the bundle is a derived, version-stamped, self-tested reproduction

phases.name: codify portable gate bundle
phases.goal: universal framework extracted as a tested template

phases.name: factory-start precondition + parity
phases.goal: gates ensured present+passing at factory project-start

phases.name: all-agent enforcement + validation
phases.goal: every lane enforces+validates the gates, proven not assumed

items.name: codify the portable gate bundle
items.goal: extract the universal framework (gate-runner, .githooks trunk-protection + pre-commit, repo-structure-lint, PM-tracker standard, behavioral-rules/role-contract/review-before-commit scaffolding) into templates/factory-gate-bundle/ with placeholders + an install manifest + a self-test; no behavior change to this repo
items.validation_goal: bundle self-test passes; manifest lists every installed file + target path; THIS repo's tier0 + hooks unchanged (source-of-truth intact)
items.editorial_note: foundational; derives from this repo's SSOT gates, records the derivation source to avoid drift

items.name: stack adapters (py/node/rust/go/nix/generic)
items.goal: stack detection + per-stack check profiles resolving concrete build/test/lint/secret-scan commands into the gate-runner
items.validation_goal: detection correct on fixture repos of each stack; generic fallback safe

items.name: greenfield injection
items.goal: extend project-init / bootstrap_agent_project to install + self-test the bundle into a new project
items.validation_goal: e2e: scaffold a throwaway repo, confirm hooks fire + gate blocks a bad commit + tracker projects

items.name: brownfield retrofit (non-destructive)
items.goal: install into an existing repo without clobbering (detect, merge-not-clobber, confirm-before-replace, Rule-12 backups)
items.validation_goal: e2e against a fixture existing repo; no existing config silently overwritten

items.name: factory-start precondition + parity + docs
items.goal: wire 'ensure gates present+passing' into the factory project-start path; parity-update agent instruction files (Rule 16); ACTIVATION-AUDIT
items.validation_goal: factory refuses/repairs a project missing gates before slice work; parity map updated

items.name: risk-tiered gate policy (cross-cutting B)
items.goal: risk classifier (compose on PRSI _risk() + high-risk-approval-rubric.json) tags changes/plans/PRDs by security/vulnerability/stability/core-piece; tier->policy map escalates reviewer count/independence, validation set, and locking (freeze + hash-bound activation) for HIGH/CORE; consulted by the gate-runner + trunk protection; recorded on the change, never self-lowered
items.validation_goal: a core/security change is auto-classified top-tier and REQUIRES the escalated gates; a routine change gets the light path; tier cannot be self-lowered (anti-gaming)
items.editorial_note: foundational cross-cutting; applied to THIS repo first then templated; composes on PRSI risk machinery (Rule 20)

items.name: all-agent enforcement + cross-lane validation (cross-cutting A)
items.goal: gates bind every lane (lane-independent hooks + gate-runner in shared commit flow); discipline parity-written into all agent instruction files from one templated source; a check PROVES each lane hits the same hooks/tier0
items.validation_goal: parity-matrix coverage complete; a commit from any lane hits identical hooks+tier0; no lane can skip trunk protection
items.editorial_note: foundational cross-cutting; applied to THIS repo first then reproduced; builds on existing lane-independent .githooks + Rule-16 parity
